name: Idun Industrier AB (publ)
summary: Idun Industrier AB (publ), an investment holding company, invests in and develops industrial and service businesses in Sweden, rest of Nordic countries, rest of Europe, and internationally. It offers safety and evaluator services; glass fiber reinforced fat- and oil separators; stainless-steel furnishings, kitchen machines, and related equipment, as well as stoves, heating cabinets, heaters, cookers, dispensers, air purification systems, and ovens; and coffins and urns.
